root_motivation: **Who:** the agent on a size budget choosing between paging and host.table.export; the agent asserting "all 143 runs succeeded". **What:** a `total` on every page with declared exactness, and a count verb that costs one indexed query. **Why not today:** `Paged` output reserves `total` and emits nothing; `host.table.query` returns rows with no count. **Consequence:** the 10-08 explore session walked 4 pages to decide there were 61 runs, then reported "about 60" (completion 0.0).
user_persona: An agent that pages host.runs.list(verdict="fail") and reads total: 7 from page 1, never walking to the end.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given this PRD has landed, When the operator runs the premise check recorded under "## Premise check (operator)", Then its result is written into this PRD and a failed premise parks the PRD (Live; evidence: operator premise check — pass, 2026-10-15)
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred -- Live: operator-provisioned premise check on prod.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given 9 999 fixture rows, When `host.table.query(limit=50)` returns page 1, Then `total: 9999` and no `total_estimate`; Given 10 001 rows, Then `total_estimate` is present, `exact: false`, and no `total` key.
Given `host.runs.list(verdict="fail")` over 60 runs with 7 failures, When page 1 returns, Then `total: 7`.

Given the two fixture tables, When `ctot_ac04_one_counter` compares the page total, `host.table.count` and `host.table.list.rows`, Then all three agree at 9 999 and all three say `exact: false` at 10 001.

scope: src/paged.rs: Count { exact, n }, EXACT_TOTAL_MAX, Count::from_bounded, Count::insert_into.
src/tables.rs: count_filtered_sync, rows_with_total, table_query, runs_list, table_list (bounded counter), table_count (new).
contracts/host-tools.v1.json: host.table.count + host_table_count entries; host.table.list exact field.
non_goals: Counts on python tool output; materialized counters per table; total for host.table.query with aggregates.

five_whys_trace.q: Why did the explore session report 'about 60' runs?
five_whys_trace.a: host.runs.list returned no total on each page, so the agent had to walk all pages to count.
The Paged output struct reserved the total field but emitted nothing.

five_whys_trace.q: Why is an exact count feasible?
five_whys_trace.a: SELECT count(*) LIMIT 10001 is bounded regardless of table size; under 10k rows it is exact and fast.
